stories.title: Flávio Bolsonaro usa interferência em debate para pedir 'voto de revolta', e campanha de Lula mira indecisos

en.title: Flávio Bolsonaro uses debate interference to call for 'protest vote', and Lula's campaign targets undecided voters
en.summary: Before the first round of elections, Lula's campaign adopts an optimistic message following recent polling data while focusing on undecided voters, who represent a small portion of decided respondents but a larger share when not prompted.

stories.title: Datafolha, 2º turno: veja como está a disputa entre Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro nos grupos sociais

en.title: Datafolha, second round: see how the dispute between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro stands in social groups
en.summary: A Datafolha poll shows Lula at 48 percent and Flávio Bolsonaro at 45 percent in a hypothetical second-round matchup, with the margin of error indicating a technical tie. Vote intentions have fluctuated among various demographic groups since campaigning began in August.

stories.title: Vídeo mostra carros de estudante de medicina e bombeiro lado a lado antes de briga de trânsito que terminou em morte em Taubaté

en.title: Video shows cars of medical student and firefighter side by side before traffic fight that ended in death in Taubaté
en.summary: Security camera footage captured the vehicles of a 23-year-old medical student and a firefighter moments before a traffic dispute that resulted in the student's death in a São Paulo city.

stories.title: Lula chama lobista amiga de Lulinha de 'Vorcaro feminino' e 'pilantra muito grande'

en.title: Lula calls lobbyist friend of Lulinha 'female Vorcaro' and 'very big scoundrel'
en.summary: President Lula compared lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger to Daniel Vorcaro, owner of a bank under investigation for alleged fraud, characterizing her as a major deceiver of many people.

stories.title: Candidatos lamentam cancelamento do debate da Globo após interferência da Justiça nas regras

en.title: Candidates regret cancellation of Globo debate after court interference in rules
en.summary: Globo cancelled a presidential debate after receiving two court orders that interfered with the previously agreed rules. Presidential candidates expressed regret over the cancellation.

stories.title: Sem debate na Globo, terceira via perde vitrine e Lula e Flávio ficam como estão, dizem analistas

en.title: Without Globo debate, third way loses spotlight and Lula and Flávio remain as they are, analysts say
en.summary: Analysts note that the cancellation of the Globo debate disadvantages third-way candidates while leaving major candidates Lula and Flávio in unchanged positions.

stories.title: Candidatos lamentam cancelamento do debate na Globo e fazem críticas a Lula, Flávio, STF e TSE

en.title: Candidates regret cancellation of debate at Globo and criticize Lula, Flávio, Supreme Court and Electoral Justice
en.summary: Following the debate cancellation, presidential candidates expressed regret and directed criticism toward major candidates and judicial institutions.

stories.title: Lives e cancelamento de debate marcam quinta-feira dos candidatos

en.title: Live streams and debate cancellation mark Thursday for candidates
en.summary: Presidential candidates conducted campaign activities including live streams and podcast interviews on Thursday as the scheduled Globo debate was cancelled.

stories.title: Lula no Flow, live de Flávio Bolsonaro e repercussão do debate cancelado na Globo

en.title: Lula on Flow, Flávio Bolsonaro's live stream and repercussion of canceled Globo debate
en.summary: The item covers President Lula's appearance on Flow, a live stream by senator Flávio Bolsonaro, and reactions to a cancelled television debate.

stories.title: Morre o piloto e youtuber Lito Sousa, aos 59 anos

en.title: Pilot and YouTuber Lito Sousa dies at 59
en.summary: Joselito Geraldo de Sousa, known as Lito Sousa, a pilot and aircraft mechanic who became an internet personality through his YouTube channel about aviation, died at age 59 from complications of Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.

stories.title: Sem debate e com duelo de lives, Lula bate Flávio no YouTube

en.title: Without debate and with live streams duel, Lula beats Flávio on YouTube
en.summary: President Lula drew more simultaneous viewers than senator Flávio Bolsonaro during competing YouTube live streams after a scheduled TV Globo debate was cancelled due to judicial decisions.

stories.title: Morre Lito Sousa, piloto e criador do canal Aviões & Músicas

en.title: Lito Sousa, pilot and creator of Aviões & Músicas channel, dies
en.summary: Lito Sousa, a pilot and creator of the Aviões & Músicas YouTube channel, died after being diagnosed with Creutzfeldt-Jakob disease.

stories.title: Live de Flávio frustra meta de visualizações e fica abaixo de audiência de Lula em podcast

en.title: Flávio's live stream falls short of viewing goal and trails Lula's podcast audience
en.summary: Presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro held a live broadcast on social media after a debate was cancelled, but failed to reach his target of 1 million simultaneous viewers, achieving around 945,000 viewers compared to President Lula's 1.5 million views on a podcast.

stories.title: Veículos novos a gasolina ficam abaixo de 50% das vendas globais pela primeira vez

en.title: New gasoline vehicles fall below 50% of global sales for the first time
en.summary: Gasoline-powered vehicles represented less than 50% of global new car sales for the first time in history, declining to 49% in the first half of the year. High oil prices and Middle East conflicts drove consumers toward electric vehicles.

stories.title: Tendências - Barcos ganham espaço no ‘real estate’

en.title: Trends - Boats gain space in real estate
en.summary: Boats are increasingly inspiring the luxury real estate market, bringing together the nautical and property sectors. Brazil's nautical industry generated 2.5 billion reais in 2025, 10% above 2024 levels, with 5,500 new units produced and over 1.1 million registered vessels.

stories.title: Quando o decorado é mero coadjuvante

en.title: When the display unit is merely a supporting player
en.summary: In the luxury real estate market, model apartments are losing importance as developers transform sales showrooms into experiential spaces featuring events and content. The strategy aims to build communities aligned with brand values before engaging potential buyers.

stories.title: PM descarta suspeita de bomba nas imediações do Supremo

en.title: Police rule out bomb suspicion near Supreme Court
en.summary: Military police dismissed bomb concerns near Brazil's Supreme Court after a man jumped over the building's gates and threw a backpack onto a nearby bus stop. The backpack contained only personal items and the suspect was arrested.
